content.title: Live Blog: Turkey vs Romania LIVE: UEFA playoff semifinal for 2026 World Cup
content.text: For the second time in the match, the team from the Carpathians hits the post.In Istanbul, Türkiye—with a very active Güler—it is a goalless draw against Romania.The ball is rolling at the Tüpraş Stadium in Istanbul, as Türkiye tries to take control against RomaniaThe UEFA playoffs for the 2026 World Cup are underway, and the clash between Turkey and Romania kicks off the race for the remaining qualification spots.The match takes place at Tüpraş Stadium as both teams aim to move one step closer to the tournament in the United States, Mexico, and Canada.The final is scheduled for March 31, where the World Cup spot will be decided.If the match ends in a draw, it will go to extra time and penalties.Turkey, coached by Vincenzo Montella, finished second in a group that included Spain and are considered slight favorites thanks to players like Arda Güler and Kenan Yildiz.Romania, led by Mircea Lucescu, finished third in their qualifying group but secured this chance through their Nations League performance.Confirmed lineups for Turkey vs Romania Turkey: Cakir; Akaydin, Aktürkoglu, Güler, Alper Yilmaz; Calhanoglu, Yildiz, Bardakci, Yuksek; Muldur, Kadoglu Romania: Radu; Ratiu, Dragusin, Burca, Bancu; Marin, Hagi, Dragomir, Man; Birligea, Mihaila Watch beIN SPORTS Xtra live for free on YouTube
